intro.text: A young Unkalaki woman who comes to Urithiru with her family and helps cook for Bridge Four.
An Unkalaki woman, daughter of Lunamor, who can see all spren and won a set of Shardplate on the voyage to Akinah.

items.text: In 1174 Cord's family travelled for months to the Shattered Plains after a message from her father. Voidbringers attacked their caravan, and they held out behind piled furniture until Bridge Four found them and escorted them to Urithiru. There Cord helped serve food to Bridge Four and took on cooking duties.
Lopen recruited Cord for the expedition to Akinah because she could see spren and wanted to see the world. Aboard the Wandersail she became the cook and discovered worms in the grain.

Cord told Lopen and Huio that her people traded with the spren world. She saw through Lopen's efforts to impress her, and told him she would not go home with her father when he returned to the Peaks to face judgement for killing Amaram.
Ashore, she made stew for the crew and told Rysn, in Veden, the Unkalaki stories of the Gods Who Sleep Not.
Nikli tried to frame Cord for poisoning the ship's pet, but Rysn saw through it, and Cord thanked her for believing she was good.
Staying aboard with Rysn at Akinah, Cord admitted she had come to win Shards for her people, fearing others would try to claim the Horneater Peaks.
When the Sleepless boarded the ship, Cord distracted Nikli by shouting in her own language, grabbed Rysn and dove into the sea.
Luckspren led them to hidden caverns holding Shardplate, Soulcasters and a mural. Cord claimed the Plate and became a Shardbearer, binding herself as a guardian.

Cord came armed for battle when the Fourth Bridge flew to Hearthstone, having shot down the Fused Leshwi in an earlier fight. When Lunamor went home to the Peaks, Cord stayed in Urithiru, still cooking with her Plate close by.

Joining Dalinar's guards for the Emul offensive, Cord shot Nale in the face with Amaram's Shardbow during a Skybreaker attack. When talks failed and Nale attacked, he caught one of her arrows from just feet away.

appearance.text: In her late teens or early twenties, tall, with bronze skin and long rusty hair. Syl thinks her more solid than the Alethi.

personality.text: Brave and adventurous, she likes proving she can do strange, new and frightening things. She does not follow Vorinism.
She loves her father and shares his gifts for seeing spren and cooking, but rejects his pacifism and means to fight Odium, stepping into his role in Urithiru.
